Jesmonite AC730 with white marble stone finish — proposal based on the standard White maker specification. The water-build formulation, sealing and waterproofing remain unconfirmed.

Individual price
£750 per individual panel — estimated price. Pump, basin, pipework and installation quoted separately.
Availability
Made to order; lead time 1–2 weeks — standing owner instruction.
